name: Editorial / Swiss
tagline: A strict grid, serious type, and one blue ink.
description: Built like a printed review. A 12-column grid, a variable serif for reading, a plain grotesk for interface text, and hairline column rules. Color is almost absent so the one cobalt accent carries meaning.

fonts.role: headlines and body text; use optical sizing

do: Lay everything on a 12-column grid with 24px gutters; let text blocks span 7 or 8 columns, not 12
Set reading text in Newsreader at 18px with a line height of 1.6 and a measure of 60 to 72 characters
Use Libre Franklin uppercase with 0.08em tracking for kickers and captions only
Separate columns with 1px hairline rules and sections with a 2px rule in line-strong
Reserve cobalt for links, kickers, and the single primary action
dont: Do not use rounded corners or shadows
Do not use more than one accent color
Do not set headlines in the grotesk
Do not use icons where a word works

components.name: Button
components.notes: Rectangular, Libre Franklin 500. Primary is a cobalt fill; secondary is a 1px ink outline; ghost is an underlined text link.

components.name: Input
components.notes: Bottom border only, label in small caps above, serif input text. Error swaps the border to danger and adds a caption.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Bottom border only with a thin chevron; reads like a form in a printed questionnaire.

components.name: Checkbox and toggle
components.notes: Square 1px checkbox with a cobalt check. Switch is a slim pill track, the only rounded shape allowed.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Uppercase Libre Franklin with tracking, no fill, a 1px rule beneath.

components.name: Card
components.notes: An article teaser: kicker, serif headline, deck, byline. Separated by hairlines rather than boxed.

components.name: Navbar
components.notes: Masthead with the serif wordmark centered above a rule, section links below in uppercase grotesk.

components.name: Modal and sheet
components.notes: Plain surface, 2px top rule, serif title, no shadow; backdrop is ink at 40 percent.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Financial-page table: hairline rows, tabular figures, a bold total row with a double rule above.

components.name: Bento grid
components.notes: A front-page layout: lead story 2x2, two briefs, a chart box, and a numbers column.

components.name: Empty state
components.notes: Centered within a column: italic serif line, caption, and a text link action.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: A thin bar with a kicker label and a one-line message, set flush to the column.
